name: When should I start the process of selling my home if I'm facing foreclosure?

mainEntity.name: When should I start the process of selling my home if I'm facing foreclosure?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should start exploring your options, including selling, as soon as you realize you are having difficulty making mortgage payments. The earlier you act, the more time you have to market your home effectively and secure a favorable sale, which is a key decision factor. Waiting until foreclosure proceedings are advanced severely limits your choices and increases pressure. Our team can help you assess your timeline and options.
acceptedAnswer.description: Start the selling process as soon as you anticipate mortgage payment difficulties to maximize your options and time.
